fill_in_the_blanks.question: Everything in this universe is made up of material which scientists have named "_______".
All the things mentioned above occupy _______ and have _______.
Early Indian philosophers classified matter in the form of five basic elements — the "_______" — air, earth, fire, sky and water.
Modern day scientists have evolved two types of classification of matter based on their _______ properties and _______ nature.
Due to its high compressibility, large volumes of a gas can be compressed into a _______ cylinder and transported easily.
The arrangement of particles is most ordered in the case of _______.
_______ is the change of solid state directly to gaseous state without going through liquid state.

true_false.statement: Everything in this universe is made up of material which scientists have named 'matter'.
Early Indian philosophers classified matter into three basic elements.
Modern day scientists classify matter based only on its physical properties.
Compressed natural gas (CNG) is used as fuel in vehicles due to its high compressibility.
In the gaseous state, the particles move about randomly at high speed.
The arrangement of particles is most ordered in the case of liquids.
Deposition is the change of gaseous state directly to solid state.

match_the_following.column_B: Used as fuel due to high compressibility
Solid state directly to gaseous state
